import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, resource
SUB="/workspace/submission/main.py"
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); path=os.path.join(d,"p.json"); inp=os.path.join(d,"in.jsonl")
prog=json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=json.dumps(
 {"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,
  "rules":[{"id":0,"class":1,"priority":5,"ranges":[[-2048,2048]]*31+[[0,0]]}]+
          [{"id":i,"class":2,"priority":1,"ranges":[[0,0]]} for i in range(1,2048)],
  "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":1},"gt":{"class":2}}}).encode(),
 stdout=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=60).stdout)
open(path,"w").write(json.dumps(prog))
# stream the request file to disk without holding it all in RAM
with open(inp,"w") as fh:
    t=0
    for f in range(4096):
        fh.write(json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":f,"time":0})+"\n")
    per=1000000//4096
    for f in range(4096):
        sent=0
        while sent<per:
            ch=[]
            for _ in range(min(1024,per-sent)):
                t+=1; ch.append({"flow":f,"time":t,"source":t%2,"length":1+((t*7919)%2048)}); sent+=1
            fh.write(json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":ch})+"\n")
    fh.write(json.dumps({"op":"checkpoint"})+"\n")
print("input file %.1fMB"%(os.path.getsize(inp)/1e6))
r0,w0=os.pipe(); r1,w1=os.pipe()
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
    os.close(w0); os.close(r1)
    os.dup2(r0,0); os.dup2(w1,1)
    fd=os.open(os.devnull,os.O_WRONLY); os.dup2(fd,2)
    os.execv(sys.executable,[sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"stream",path])
os.close(r0); os.close(w1)
with open(inp,"rb") as fh:
    while True:
        b=fh.read(1<<20)
        if not b: break
        os.write(w0,b)
os.close(w0)
total=0
while True:
    b=os.read(r1,1<<20)
    if not b: break
    total+=len(b)
os.close(r1)
_,status,ru=os.wait4(pid,0)
print("status=%d out=%.2fMB peakrss=%.1fMB"%(status,total/1e6,ru.ru_maxrss/1024))
PYEOF
